title: Access policy
description: Limit where people can sign in and work from. Locked spaces are set from each space's menu.
adminOnly: Only administrators can manage the access policy.
error: The access policy could not be loaded.
ip.title: IP allowlist
ip.hint: When on, signing in and every request from any other network address is refused. Public forms, public dashboard links, provisioning and webhooks are not affected.
ip.listHint: One per line, for example 203.0.113.7 or 203.0.113.0/24. IPv6 works too. At most 50.
ip.yourAddress: Your address as the server sees it: {{ip}}
ip.override: The server is running with the allowlist override, so this list is not being enforced.
ip.recovery: Locked everyone out? Ask the operator to set PMS_DISABLE_IP_ALLOWLIST=true and restart.
conflict: Someone changed the policy. Reload and try again.
saveFailed: The policy could not be saved.
otp.title: Sign in with a code
otp.hint: People can ask for a six-digit code by email instead of typing a password. It works once, expires in 10 minutes and allows five tries. Two-factor, if a person uses it, is still asked.
otp.enabled: Allow signing in with an emailed code
ip.lockoutWarning: Your address {{ip}} is not in this list. Saving with the allowlist on may lock you out.
